patch_list: TFD Companion - NGSM validation diagnostics - Troubleshooting purpose
Logs NGSM token-result codes and failed validation values under TFD-NGSM. Does not log tokens or change authentication results.
TFD Companion - Remove illegal apps detection
Removes broad MAIN/VIEW package queries while preserving specific app integrations. For Android 11+. Leaves NGSM and authentication unchanged; other detections may still occur.
